title: SSD Offloading for LLM Mixture-of-Experts Weights Considered Harmful in Energy Efficiency (Kyung, Yun, Ahn; arXiv 2508.06978v1, 9 Aug 2025)
setup: Simulator (not measured) of DGX-H100-like node, 8xH100, 256GB DDR5+NVMe per GPU, GPUDirect, NVLink4; Mixtral 8x7B, DeepSeek-R1, Llama4 Maverick, Llama3.3 70B; BF16; uniform-random routing; L_in 1024, first decode step

numbers.what: energy per token SSD vs HBM, Mixtral
energy per token SSD vs HBM, R1

numbers.ratio: unique experts 7.9/8 and 223/256 by uniform formula (my arithmetic)

catalog_numbers_correct.claim: first pass omitted: simulator only, uniform random routing

why: Only the saturation formula carries over; energy paper, GPU, simulated, uniform routing
limitations: Current SSD energy; future flash could change result

title: MoE-Lightning: High-Throughput MoE Inference on Memory-constrained GPUs (Cao et al.; arXiv 2411.11217v1, 18 Nov 2024)
setup: S1 Mixtral 8x7B 1xT4 16GB Xeon 24c 192GB; S2 1xL4 24GB; S6/S7 8x22B 2/4xT4 416GB; MTBench/HELM; baselines FlexGen, FlexGen(c), DeepSpeed 0.14.3; no disk offload

catalog_numbers_correct.claim: up to 10.3x Mixtral 8x7B one T4 offline
catalog_numbers_correct.true_value: caption ties it to S1 and S2 (T4 and L4), unpadded vs padded FlexGen

why: GPU, model fully in host RAM (disk is future work), offline large batch
ablation: Table 5: policy, batch size, CGOPipe; no cache/layout/prefetch
limitations: Disk offloading future work; CPU attention can bottleneck

title: MoE-Gen: High-Throughput MoE Inference on a Single GPU with Module-Based Batching (Xu et al.; arXiv 2503.09716v1, 12 Mar 2025)
setup: C1 A5000 24GB + AMD 7453 + 256GB; C2 512GB; C3 A6000; Mixtral 8x7B/8x22B, DeepSeek-V2, R1; baselines llama.cpp, vLLM, DeepSpeed, FlexGen* and MoE-Lightning* (authors' reimplementations)

numbers.what: tokens per expert to hide transfer

catalog_numbers_correct.claim: needs more than 2^11 tokens per expert

why: GPU, host RAM, thousands of tokens batched; 2^11 tokens/expert at 512 experts top-10 is about 105k tokens (my arithmetic)
ablation: G vs H (CPU attention), omega sweep, small-batch Table 9
limitations: Gains shrink with small batches/long context; no expert prediction

title: ExpertFlow: Optimized Expert Activation and Token Allocation for Efficient MoE Inference (v1) / Efficient MoE Inference via Predictive Expert Caching and Token Scheduling (v2) (He et al.; arXiv 2410.17954 v1 23 Oct 2024, v2 2 Apr 2026)
setup: One A40 48GB + Xeon Gold 6338; Switch-32/64/128, Mixtral 8x7B (v1+v2), Qwen1.5-MoE, DeepSeek-MoE (v2); WMT16, XSUM; baselines Cache-MoE LRU, SE-MoE, Pregated-MoE; batch 4-32; trained 7.21MB routing predictor per model/dataset

numbers.what: hit ratio PLEC vs LRU Switch-32 CS8 BS16

catalog_numbers_correct.claim: up to 10x over strong offloading baselines
catalog_numbers_correct.true_value: 10x is vs SE-MoE on Switch-128 cache 4; vs Cache-MoE 1.94-2.12x
token scheduler gives only 1.03-1.19x; gain is predictor + predictive cache
but catalog cites v1 whose TS numbers are 1.09-1.19x

why: GPU A40, batch>=4, headline on top-1 Switch, predictor must be trained per model, no NVMe, no batch 1
ablation: TS alone, PLEC vs LRU hit ratio, pipeline overhead
limitations: batch-1 not evaluated; larger batch lowers hit ratio

title: Dynamic Expert Sharing: Decoupling Memory from Parallelism in MoE Diffusion LLMs (Chen et al.; arXiv 2602.00879v1, 31 Jan 2026)
setup: LLaDA2.0-Mini 16B (256 experts, top-8), LLaDA-MoE-7B (64 experts); block length 32; NVIDIA B200 + Xeon 6960P; baselines top-k=4, NAEE, MC-MoE

catalog_numbers_correct.claim: unique experts grow nearly linearly with parallel tokens

why: Diffusion decoding, GPU HBM, lossy routing; only diagnosis transfers
ablation: coreset size, block size, Seq vs Vote, fused kernel
limitations: none stated in a dedicated section
contradicts_our_findings: no (supports: real/random sharing ratio ~1.94 vs our 2.0)

title: Klotski: Efficient Mixture-of-Expert Inference via Expert-Aware Multi-Batch Pipeline (Fang et al.; arXiv 2502.06888v1, 9 Feb 2025)
setup: Env1 RTX3090 24GB + Xeon 5318Y 256GB + SSD 1GB/s; Env2 H800 80GB, 800GB; Mixtral 8x7B/8x22B bf16; wikitext-103, in 512 out 32, batch 4-64, n up to 15 batches; baselines Accelerate, FastGen, FlexGen, Fiddler, MoE-Infinity
why: GPU, many batches in flight, aggregate throughput (per-sequence ~0.002 tok/s for 8x22B Env1, my arithmetic)
